title: Timestamped Record Store with Range Query
description_html:
Implement a record storage system where each record has content and a timestamp. Support:

  • add(content, timestamp)
  • remove(timestamp)
  • search(timestamp) — the record(s) at an exact timestamp
  • search(timestamp1, timestamp2) — all records with timestamp in [t1, t2]

You may not use a built-in ordered container (e.g. TreeMap) — implement the ordered index yourself.

Example

add("a", 1); add("b", 5); add("c", 3)
search(3)        -> "c"
search(1, 4)     -> ["a", "c"]      # timestamps 1 and 3
remove(3); search(1, 4) -> ["a"]

Roll your own ordered structure (BST / skip list / sorted array). See Notes.
